description: Create two Airflow DAGs with cross-DAG dependency. DAG A runs hourly and produces aggregated metrics in a BigQuery table. DAG B runs daily and depends on all 24 hourly runs of DAG A completing for the logical date. DAG B should use ExternalTaskSensor to wait for DAG A's completion. DAG B processes the aggregated data and produces a daily summary report.
edge_cases: ExternalTaskSensor must check all 24 hourly executions, not just the one matching execution_date
If DAG A fails for one hour, DAG B should not proceed
Timezone handling: DAG A runs in UTC; DAG B must match
common_failure_modes: FM6: ExternalTaskSensor checks only one execution_date instead of all 24 hours
FM2: execution_delta calculation incorrect across DST boundaries
